title_as_printed: Experimental Mixture Data (NaCl-CaCl2 mixtures at constant ionic strength I = 5, 2, 1)

value.what: density difference d - d0, reference not defined in table (presumably pure water at same T)

composition.other_species: NaCl + CaCl2 mixture at constant ionic strength I (1, 2 or 5, set by label rows; unit presumably mol/kg, matches the single-salt molalities of Table I); y_b is not defined in the paper's text; y_b = 0 is pure NaCl and 1 is pure CaCl2, and densities match Table I at the corresponding molalities, so y_b is presumably the ionic-strength fraction of CaCl2.

extra_unmapped: -10^4 phik*, cm3 mol-1 bar-1 (mean apparent molal compressibility, calculated)
U-U0, cm s-1 (sound-velocity difference from pure water, measured; not a database property)
phiV, cm3 mol-1 (apparent molal volume, calculated by the authors)
conversion_needs: ionic strength (mol/kg presumed) and y_b to salt molalities: NaCl m = I(1-y_b), CaCl2 m = I*y_b/3 if y_b is the ionic-strength fraction
notes: Label rows: first block of each temperature reads 'T = x C, I = 5', later blocks 'I = 2' and 'I = 1'.
quality_remarks: y_b is not defined in the paper text; it is read as the ionic-strength fraction of CaCl2 (NaCl m = I(1-y), CaCl2 m = I*y/3, I in mol/kg water). This is data-supported (Young's-rule densities from Table I reproduce the interior rows to <0.5%) but not quoted from the paper. Reference density d0 is not stated (pure water at the same T, confirmed by recomputing phiV). No pressure is printed.
